actions.detail: Preflight and WorkPreflight froze the exact 50-same-body, different-body, terminal-race, event-race, and report contract under the local P03-007 dependency projection.

Added real PostgreSQL CT-001/CT-002 and concurrency regressions at the current FORCE-RLS migration head, plus Harness 05/34 S/I/D controls. No Runtime implementation, model, in-memory lock, production database, or external object was changed.

The first direct affected suite passed all 11 tests, including 50 same-body callers, different-body conflict, two-way terminal CAS, 50 concurrent event writers, post-terminal rejection, and both Harness controls.
Added exact task-gate adapters and evidence binding for P03-008 without changing Catalog bytes or any Runtime implementation.
The complete Agent CI suite passed with 211 unit/integration tests and 44 contract tests, plus formatting, lint, type, secret, license, dependency-audit, and clock-contract checks.
